summary: This clinical trial is studying omega-3 fatty acids, which are a type of fat found mostly in fish oil, to see how they affect risk factors for type 2 diabetes. The study is sponsored by Institut de Recherches Cliniques de Montreal and aims to include 48 participants who have normal blood LDL cholesterol. Currently, the trial's status is Recruiting and it has No phase.

facts.sponsor: Institut de Recherches Cliniques de Montreal
